example.title: Warehouse row of the former Union Fishermen's cannery on pilings, Uniontown

brief: A row of three tall gabled cannery and warehouse sheds side by side out on the river, clad in weathered white vertical boards and grey metal, green-painted roofs, joined along the water side by a sagging timber plank apron on piles; stub piles of vanished wharves stand in rows in the shallows. One photo. Older than 1970: West Coast salmon and sardine canneries on piles were all built before 1970, so no newer example of this kind exists. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
